page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.8xlarge is a memory-optimized instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at 2.7 GHz with an x86_64 architecture. The hardware configuration includes 256.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPUs, relying entirely on network-attached storage and featuring a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

Benchmark results place the ecs.r7.8xlarge in the average performance tier across most compute and memory tests. The single-core stress-ng CPU performance is recorded at 1865.39, while multi-core performance reaches 30983.52. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only small block cached speed of 1689.81 GB/sec and a large block uncached speed of 141.73 GB/sec. For LLM inference, the instance demonstrates strong performance in text generation with a small 135M model at 282.15 tokens/sec, though performance drops to an average 17.54 tokens/sec for text generation with a medium 7B model.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.r7.8xlarge offers high memory density relative to its compute resources, making it suitable for memory-bound workloads. However, the lack of local storage and dedicated GPU hardware represents a tradeoff, requiring external storage solutions and limiting its utility for heavy graphics or massive parallel AI training. This instance is well-suited for database operations, Redis caching layers, software compilation, and medium-scale text processing or inference tasks.
